<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" id="Definitions_LuxuryAirplane" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/luxury-airplane">
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Specifications" name="Customer specifications"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Requirements" name="Part requirements"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Parts" name="Manufactured parts"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_TestProtocol" name="Test protocol"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Delivery" name="Airplane delivery"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Confirmation" name="Delivery confirmation"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_LuxuryAirplane">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Customer" name="Customer"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Manufacturer" name="Airplane Manufacturer" processRef="Process_Manufacturer"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_PartTeams" name="Part Manufacturing Teams"/>

    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_Specifications" name="Specifications" messageRef="Msg_Specifications" sourceRef="Participant_Customer" targetRef="StartEvent_Specifications"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_Requirements" name="Requirements" messageRef="Msg_Requirements" sourceRef="SendTask_SendRequirements" targetRef="Participant_PartTeams"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_Parts" name="Manufactured parts" messageRef="Msg_Parts" sourceRef="Participant_PartTeams" targetRef="ReceiveTask_ReceiveParts"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_TestProtocol" name="Test protocol" messageRef="Msg_TestProtocol" sourceRef="SendTask_SendProtocol" targetRef="Participant_Customer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_Delivery" name="Airplane delivery" messageRef="Msg_Delivery" sourceRef="SendTask_DeliverAirplane" targetRef="Participant_Customer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_Confirmation" name="Delivery confirmation" messageRef="Msg_Confirmation" sourceRef="Participant_Customer" targetRef="ReceiveTask_ReceiveConfirmation"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Manufacturer" name="Airplane Manufacturer Process" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Specifications" name="Specifications received">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_1</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_Specifications" messageRef="Msg_Specifications"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_SendRequirements" name="Send requirements to part teams" messageRef="Msg_Requirements">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_2</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="ReceiveTask_ReceiveParts" name="Receive manufactured parts" messageRef="Msg_Parts">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_2</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_3</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:receiveTask>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AssembleInterior" name="Assemble interior">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_3</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_4</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_TestFlight" name="Perform test flight">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_4</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_5</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CreateTestProtocol" name="Create test protocol during flight">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_5</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_6</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_SendProtocol" name="Send test protocol to customer" messageRef="Msg_TestProtocol">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_6</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_7</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_DeliverAirplane" name="Deliver airplane to customer" messageRef="Msg_Delivery">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_7</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_8</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="ReceiveTask_ReceiveConfirmation" name="Receive delivery confirmation" messageRef="Msg_Confirmation">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_8</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_9</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:receiveTask>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Delivered" name="Airplane delivered and confirmed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_9</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_1" sourceRef="StartEvent_Specifications" targetRef="SendTask_SendRequirements"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_2" sourceRef="SendTask_SendRequirements" targetRef="ReceiveTask_ReceiveParts"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_3" sourceRef="ReceiveTask_ReceiveParts" targetRef="Task_AssembleInterior"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_4" sourceRef="Task_AssembleInterior" targetRef="Task_TestFlight"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_5" sourceRef="Task_TestFlight" targetRef="Task_CreateTestProtocol"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_6" sourceRef="Task_CreateTestProtocol" targetRef="SendTask_SendProtocol"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_7" sourceRef="SendTask_SendProtocol" targetRef="SendTask_DeliverAirplane"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_8" sourceRef="SendTask_DeliverAirplane" targetRef="ReceiveTask_ReceiveConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_9" sourceRef="ReceiveTask_ReceiveConfirmation" targetRef="EndEvent_Delivered"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
